A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

items.name: Possession
items.notes:
One humanoid that Celeste can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by Celeste; Celeste then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Celeste now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Celeste can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Celeste ends it as a bonus action, or Celeste is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Celeste reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

Marisa can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Marisa ends it as a bonus action, or Marisa is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Marisa reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

items.name: Possession
items.notes: One humanoid that Meri can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or be possessed by Meri; Meri then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Meri now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Meri can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, Meri ends it as a bonus action, or Meri is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Meri reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.
